name: Spotify
description: Spotify is a music and audio streaming service whose developer platform offers the Web API and SDKs that authenticate apps with OAuth 2.0 client credentials and tokens.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Candidate families were enumerated from the Spotify for Developers pages Authorization, Apps, Access Token, Refreshing tokens and Client credentials, read on 2026-10-04 (the five developer.spotify.com sources recorded under records/sources/developer-spotify-com). The Client ID is a public identifier of an app and is not a family; it is a benign sibling of the client secret for a later family run. The list is what those pages name, not a complete inventory.
